```{r}

library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(summarytools)
library(gmodels)
```

```{r}
lbw_data <- read_excel("data/Low birth weight.xlsx")

lbw_data
```

```{r}
lbw_data %>% 
    select(low, smoke, ptl, ht, ui, ftv)%>% 
    freq()
```

```{r}
lbw_data %>% 
    select(age, lwt, bwt) %>% 
    summary()
```

```{r}
lbw_data %>% 
    select(age, lwt, bwt) %>% 
    summarise(standard_deviation_age = sd(age),
              standard_deviation_lwt = sd(lwt),
              standard_deviation_bwt = sd(bwt),
              mean_age = mean(age),
              mean_lwt = mean(lwt),
              mean_bwt = mean(bwt)
              )
```

```{r}
lbw_data %>% 
    select(age, lwt, bwt) %>% 
    summarise(standard_deviation_age = sd(age),
              mean_age = mean(age)
              )
```

```{r}
lbw_data %>% 
    group_by(ftv) %>% 
    summarise(standard_deviation_age = sd(age),
              standard_deviation_lwt = sd(lwt),
              standard_deviation_bwt = sd(bwt),
              mean_age = mean(age),
              mean_lwt = mean(lwt),
              mean_bwt = mean(bwt)
              )
    
```

```{r}
lbw_factor <- lbw_data %>% 
    select(low, smoke, ptl, ht, ui, ftv) %>% 
    mutate(low = factor(low, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c('No', 'Yes')))

lbw_factor
```

```{r}

lbw_data_groups <- lbw_data %>%
    mutate(
        age_group = case_when(
            age < 18 ~ "Underage",
            age < 35 & age >= 18 ~ "Young Adult",
            age >= 35 ~ "Adult",
            TRUE ~ NA_character_
        ),
        lwt_kg = round(lwt * 0.45359237),
        mother_weight_group = case_when(
            lwt_kg < 50 ~ "Underweight",
            lwt_kg < 70 & lwt_kg >= 50 ~ "Normal Weight",
            lwt_kg < 90 & lwt_kg >= 70 ~ "Overweight",
            lwt_kg >= 90 ~ "Obese"
        ),
        bwt_group = case_when(
            bwt < 2500 ~ "Underweight",
            bwt < 4000 & bwt >= 2500 ~ "Normal Weight",
            bwt >= 4000 ~ "Overweight"
        )
        
    ) %>% 
    mutate(age_group = factor(age_group, levels = c("Underage",
                                                    "Young Adult", 
                                                    "Adult")))
 
lbw_data_groups   

```

```{r}

lbw_data_groups %>% 
    group_by(age_group) %>% 
    summarise(mean_lwt_kg = mean(lwt_kg))
```

```{r}

lbw_data_groups %>% 
    select(contains('group')) %>% 
    freq()
    
```

```{r}

lbw_by_lwt <- glm(low ~ lwt, family = binomial(link = 'logit'), data = lbw_data)

lbw_by_lwt
```

```{r}
coef(lbw_by_lwt)
```

```{r}
confint(lbw_by_lwt)
```

```{r}
cbind(OR = coef(lbw_by_lwt), confint(lbw_by_lwt))
```

```{r}
exp(cbind(OR = coef(lbw_by_lwt), confint(lbw_by_lwt)))
```

```{r}
low_by_ftv <- glm(low ~ ftv, family = binomial(link = "logit"), data = lbw_data)

low_by_ftv
```

```{r}
exp(cbind(OR = coef(low_by_ftv), confint(low_by_ftv)))
```

```{r}
low_by_ht_smoke <- glm(low ~ ht + smoke, family = binomial(link = "logit"), data = lbw_data)

low_by_ht_smoke
```

```{r}
exp(cbind(OR = coef(low_by_ht_smoke), confint(low_by_ht_smoke)))
```

```{r}

lbw_data_groups %>% 
    ggplot(aes(y = bwt)) +
    geom_boxplot()
```

```{r}
lbw_data_groups %>% 
    ggplot(aes(y = bwt, x = mother_weight_group)) +
    geom_boxplot(fill = "orange") +
    theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
lbw_data_groups %>% 
    ggplot(aes(y = bwt, 
               x = mother_weight_group, 
               fill = mother_weight_group)) +
    geom_boxplot() +
    labs(title = "Distribution of Birthweight by Weight of the Mother",
         x = "Mother's Weight Group",
         y = "Birthweight") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.major.x = element_blank())
```

```{r}
lbw_data_groups %>% 
    ggplot(aes(y = bwt, 
               x = mother_weight_group, 
               fill = mother_weight_group)) +
    geom_boxplot() +
    labs(title = "Distribution of Birthweight by Weight of the Mother",
         x = "Mother's Weight Group",
         y = "Birthweight") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank())
```

```{r}
lbw_data_groups %>% 
    ggplot(aes(y = bwt, x = age_group)) +
    geom_boxplot()
```

```{r}
lbw_data_groups %>% 
    ggplot(aes(y = bwt, x = age)) +
    geom_point(color = "purple")
```

```{r}
lbw_data_groups %>% 
    ggplot(aes(y = bwt, x = age, colour = age_group)) +
    geom_point()
```

```{r}
lbw_data_groups %>% 
    ggplot(aes(y = bwt, x = age, colour = ht)) +
    geom_point()
```

```{r}
lbw_data_groups %>% 
    ggplot(aes(y = bwt, x = age, colour = ftv)) +
    geom_point()
```

```{r}
lbw_data_groups %>% 
    ggplot(aes(y = bwt, x = age, colour = bwt_group)) +
    geom_point() +
    geom_smooth()
```

```{r}
lbw_data_groups %>% 
    ggplot(aes(y = bwt, x = age)) +
    geom_point(aes(colour = bwt_group)) +
    geom_smooth(method = 'lm', se = FALSE)
```

```{r}
lbw_data_groups %>% 
    ggplot(aes(y = bwt, 
               x = mother_weight_group, 
               fill = mother_weight_group)) +
    geom_boxplot() +
    labs(title = "Distribution of Birthweight by Weight of the Mother",
         x = "Mother's Weight Group",
         y = "Birthweight") +
    theme_light()
```
